masteryZone.q: In which month is the Kharif crop generally sown?
masteryZone.sol: Kharif is sown in June-July with the summer monsoon.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following is a Rabi crop?
masteryZone.sol: Wheat is a winter-sown Rabi crop.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Zaid crops are harvested in the winter season.
masteryZone.sol: False. Zaid crops are grown and harvested in the summer season (March-June).

masteryZone.q: Name one example of a Zaid crop.
Which country is the largest producer of Rice in the world?
masteryZone.sol: China is the largest rice producer, with India ranking second.

masteryZone.q: What type of soil is ideal for Wheat?
masteryZone.sol: Well-drained loamy soils are ideal for wheat growth.

masteryZone.q: True or False: India is the largest exporter of Rice in the world.
masteryZone.sol: True. India leads global rice exports with nearly 40% market share.

masteryZone.q: Which coarse grain is also known as Finger Millet?
Which crop is known as the 'Golden Fibre'?
masteryZone.sol: Jute is known as the Golden Fibre.

masteryZone.q: How many frost-free days does Cotton require?
masteryZone.sol: Cotton requires 210 frost-free days to mature safely.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Sugarcane requires a cool, dry desert climate to mature.
masteryZone.sol: False. Sugarcane requires hot, humid climate and moderate rainfall.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Jute is primarily grown in flood plains where soils are renewed every year.
masteryZone.sol: True. Well-drained renewal soils of floodplains are perfect for Jute.

masteryZone.q: Which state of India is the largest producer of Coffee?
masteryZone.sol: Karnataka produces over 70% of India's coffee.

masteryZone.q: Tea grows best in which type of soil?
opts: Well-drained acidic soil rich in humus
masteryZone.sol: Acidic, organic-rich, well-drained loamy soils on hill slopes are ideal for tea.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Coffee plants are highly resistant to direct sunlight and do not need shade.
masteryZone.sol: False. Coffee requires shade trees to protect it from harsh direct sun rays.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The Arabica coffee variety grown in India was originally imported from Yemen.
masteryZone.sol: True. The Yemen origin Arabica variety is widely grown in India.
